The '''Frozen Waste Plateau''', also known as '''Ice Plateau ''' (or historically [[Ghorrock]]), is located in the north-west corner of the [[Wilderness]]. The area spans both [[free-to-play]] and [[members]] areas. It contains [[ice giant]]s and [[ice warrior]]s in the free-to-play area. In the member's area, [[ice spider]]s can also be found. There are also spawns of [[water rune]]s and [[cosmic rune]]s.

Notably, three [[runite rocks]] can be found in the members' only area of the plateau.

==Transportation==
The area can be quickly accessed using the [[Ghorrock Teleport]] from the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook (south of the [[Wilderness fence]]) at Level 96 Magic, or the [[Ice Plateau Teleport]] from the [[Lunar spells|Lunar spellbook]] (north of the wilderness fence) at Level 89 Magic. Portals to each of these locations can be built in a [[Portal chamber]] in a [[Player-owned house]].
